zh: 修复粘贴图片和插入引用后原生输入框仍停在旧位置、草稿不同步的问题；组合输入期间保持字段稳定。消息中的非图片附件改为紧凑文件条，保留名称、类型和大小，图片缩略图保持原有行为。
en: Fix native-input positioning and draft synchronization after pasted images and inserted quotes while preserving composition stability. Show sent non-image attachments as compact file rows with their name, type and size; preserve image thumbnails.
